seoTitle: Which Game of Thrones Character Are You? GoT Test (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Game of Thrones test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Jon Snow, Daenerys, Tyrion, Cersei, Arya, Sansa, Jaime or Ned Stark — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the reluctant hero who never wanted power, the queen who wants to break the wheel, or the clever one everyone underestimates? Answer 12 questions about how you really handle power, loyalty and betrayal, and find out which Game of Thrones character you are.

characters.name: Jon Snow
characters.title: The Reluctant Hero
characters.summary: Honourable, brooding and always doing the right thing — even when it costs you. You never wanted to lead, but people keep following you.
description: Like Jon, you believe in duty. He joined the Night's Watch, rose to lead it and never stopped trying to protect the realm.
You're honourable to a fault. Jon does the right thing even when everyone tells him it's a terrible idea.
You don't want power — which is exactly why people trust you with it. You know nothing, and you're fine with that.
characters.flaw: You trust too easily and make decisions with your heart.
characters.signature: A direwolf, a black cloak and a very serious expression.
characters.clashReason: they'd do the honourable thing even when it's stupid

characters.name: Daenerys Targaryen
characters.title: The Unstoppable Conqueror
characters.summary: Ambitious, determined and fiercely convinced you're meant for more. You don't want to play the game — you want to break the wheel.
description: Like Daenerys, you've come from nothing. She went from a powerless exile to the Mother of Dragons.
You want to change the world, not just rule it. Daenerys freed slaves across Essos and vowed to break the wheel of power.
But you're dangerously certain you're right, and that certainty can burn everything down.
characters.flaw: You believe so strongly in your destiny that you stop listening.
characters.signature: Silver hair, three dragons and a very long list of titles.

characters.name: Tyrion Lannister
characters.title: The Clever Survivor
characters.summary: Witty, brilliant and underestimated by everyone. You drink and you know things.
description: Like Tyrion, you use your mind to survive. He's the smartest person in almost every room — and the one people underestimate most.
You're funny, cynical and a great talker. Tyrion can talk his way out of almost anything.
Underneath the wit, you care about people who've been treated unfairly, because you know how it feels.
characters.flaw: You drink too much and your mouth gets you into trouble.
characters.signature: A cup of wine, a book and a devastating one-liner.
characters.clashReason: they'd outtalk you and drink your wine

characters.name: Cersei Lannister
characters.title: The Ruthless Queen
characters.summary: Proud, cunning and ferociously protective of your own. You play the game of thrones to win.
description: Like Cersei, you want power — and you know how to get it. She fought her way to the Iron Throne in a world that didn't want a woman on it.
You're ferociously protective of your children. Everything Cersei does, she says she does for them.
You're cunning and proud, and you'll destroy anyone who stands in your way.
characters.flaw: Your pride and paranoia make enemies of everyone.
characters.signature: A goblet of wine and a cold smile.
characters.clashReason: they'd crush anyone who gets in their way — including you

characters.name: Arya Stark
characters.title: The Fearless Rebel
characters.summary: Independent, fierce and never one for the rules. You'd rather fight than sew — and you don't forget a wrong.
description: Like Arya, you never fit the mould. She wanted a sword, not a needle — so she named her sword Needle.
You're a survivor. Arya endured the worst the world could throw at her and came back a trained assassin.
You don't forget. Arya kept a list of names — and worked her way through it.
characters.signature: A small sword called Needle and a list of names.
characters.clashReason: they'd never do what they're told

characters.name: Sansa Stark
characters.title: The Strategic Survivor
characters.summary: Graceful, patient and much smarter than people realise. You learned the game from the best — and beat them.
description: Like Sansa, you started out believing in songs and fairytales. The world taught you otherwise.
You learned by watching. Sansa survived Cersei, Littlefinger and worse, and picked up every lesson along the way.
In the end, you become one of the smartest players of all — and the Queen in the North.
characters.flaw: You can be cold once you've been burned.
characters.signature: An elegant gown, a steely look and a crown.
characters.clashReason: they'd play the long game and beat you at it

characters.name: Jaime Lannister
characters.title: The Flawed Knight
characters.summary: Arrogant, charming and far more complicated than your reputation. You've done terrible things — and you're trying to be better.
description: Like Jaime, you've got a reputation. He's the Kingslayer, the knight who broke his oath — for reasons nobody knew.
You're cocky and charming, and you're used to being the best fighter in the room.
But you change. Jaime's journey — and his friendship with Brienne — revealed a man trying to be honourable.
characters.flaw: You keep going back to the thing that's bad for you.
characters.signature: Golden armour and a golden hand.

characters.name: Ned Stark
characters.title: The Honourable Lord
characters.summary: Principled, loyal and unwilling to compromise. You'd rather be right than safe.
description: Like Ned, you live by a code. Honour, duty and family come first.
You're a devoted parent and a fair leader. Ned taught his children to face hard truths directly.
But honour can be dangerous in a world of liars. Winter is coming — and you'll face it head-on.
characters.flaw: You refuse to play dirty — even when your life depends on it.
characters.signature: A greatsword called Ice and a reminder that winter is coming.
characters.clashReason: they'd never bend a rule, even to save themselves

questions.text: You're offered a big promotion — but you'd have to step on a friend to get it. You...

options.text: Turn it down. Not like that
Take it. That's how the world works
Find a clever way to get the job and keep the friend
Yes. You've waited your whole life for this
Remember it. Forever. You'll get round to them
Make them pay — publicly
Smile, wait, learn — then win
Tell them to their face

questions.text: You're told how someone like you is supposed to behave. You...

options.text: Do the complete opposite
Play the part perfectly. It's useful
Make a very sarcastic comment
Decide it's time someone changed the rules — you

questions.text: Your group needs a leader, and everyone's looking at you. You...

options.text: Step up, reluctantly. Someone has to
Finally. You've been ready for years
Suggest someone better — and offer to advise them
Lead by example: fair, honest and firm

questions.text: A free evening. You spend it...

options.text: With a good book and a better bottle of wine
Out on your own, exploring somewhere new
Hosting dinner and making sure everyone's comfortable
At the gym. You're the best and you'd like to stay that way

questions.text: Someone you love is bad for you, and everyone can see it but you. You...

options.text: Keep going back. You can't help it
Walk away. It hurts, but duty comes first
Refuse to believe it — until it's far too late
Joke about it. Then drink about it

questions.text: You made a promise, and keeping it now will cost you dearly. You...

options.text: Keep it. Your word is everything
Break it — if breaking it saves lives
Walk away from it without a second thought
Honour it — and hold everyone else to their word too

questions.text: Someone new at work acts like they're in charge of you. You...

options.text: Correct them. Politely, once
Ignore them and do it your own way
Laugh. They'll figure it out
Let them. They'll show you all their weaknesses

questions.text: A huge threat is coming, and everyone else is ignoring it. You...

options.text: Warn everyone, again and again, even when they laugh
Quietly stock up and get your own people ready
Ignore it. You've got your own war to win
Go and deal with it yourself — alone if you have to

questions.text: You're far from home and completely alone. You...

options.text: Learn to survive. Become someone else if you have to
Gather the people nobody else would help, and build something
Talk your way into the safest company you can find
Find new people to call family

questions.text: Your family is at war with another family. The only way to end it is to marry into theirs. You...

options.text: Do it. Your family comes first
Refuse. That's not who you are
Agree — then work out how to run their family from the inside
Say yes, if it saves lives. Your own happiness can wait

questions.text: You've won a war. The people who fought against you are kneeling in front of you. You...

options.text: Show mercy. People can change
Demand they swear loyalty to you — or face the consequences
Make an example of their leaders. Nobody tries this again
Carry out any sentence yourself. You won't hide behind others
